006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * Represents a named model instance with absolute positioning and JSON
015 * serialization support.
016 * <p>
017 * Provides JSON name resolution based on cardinality and grouping behavior,
018 * with support for JSON key configuration.
019 */
020public interface INamedModelInstanceAbsolute extends INamedModelInstance, IModelInstanceAbsolute, IJsonInstance {
021  @Override
022  default String getJsonName() {
023    @NonNull
024    String retval;
025    if (getMaxOccurs() == -1 || getMaxOccurs() > 1) {
026      @NonNull
027      String groupAsName = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(getGroupAsName(),
028          ObjectUtils.notNull(String.format("null group-as name in instance '%s' on definition '%s' in '%s'",
029              this.getName(),
030              this.getContainingDefinition().getName(),
031              this.getContainingModule().getLocation())));
032      retval = groupAsName;
033    } else {
034      retval = getEffectiveName();
035    }
036    return retval;
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  @Nullable
041  default IFlagInstance getEffectiveJsonKey() {
042    return getJsonGroupAsBehavior() == JsonGroupAsBehavior.KEYED
043        ? getJsonKey()
044        : null;
045  }
046
047  @Override
048  @Nullable
049  default IFlagInstance getJsonKey() {
050    return getDefinition().getJsonKey();
051  }
052}
